description: Test suite for Huffman transcoder in HTTP/2 HPACK implementation, including roundtrip tests for encoding and decoding of strings with various characters.

classes.name: HpackHuffmanTranscoderTest
classes.description: Test fixture for Huffman transcoder tests, providing methods for encoding, decoding, and validation.

classes.name: HpackHuffmanTranscoderAdjacentCharTest
classes.description: Parameterized test for adjacent character roundtrip testing.

classes.name: HpackHuffmanTranscoderRepeatedCharTest
classes.description: Parameterized test for repeated character roundtrip testing.

methods.name: GenAsciiNonControlSet
methods.description: Generates a string of ASCII characters from space to DEL (0x20 to 0x7F).

methods.name: StartDecoding
methods.description: Initializes decoding process, resets counters and decoder state.

methods.name: ResumeDecoding
methods.description: Continues decoding from buffer, updates counters, and checks for completion or errors.

methods.name: RandomAsciiNonControlString

methods.description: Generates a string of random bytes.
